scope: Exact UTF-8 source declaration/header/body identity, not elaborated-term or kernel acceptance. No Lean, Lake, checker or cloud job invoked.
byte_offset_and_hash_convention: Offsets are zero-based half-open byte ranges. Declaration hashes cover exactly those raw source ranges, including attached doc comments and trailing whitespace. Header-and-type ranges end immediately before the first :=; body ranges begin immediately after it.
